profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Enterprise Platform Engineering & AI-Native Delivery
profile.summary:
I design and scale enterprise developer platforms used by thousands of engineers - built to reduce friction, accelerate delivery, and grow with the teams that depend on them.

As a Senior Staff Platform Engineer at The Hartford, I lead strategy and architecture across internal developer platforms, CI/CD, DevOps intelligence, and AI-native tooling.

My focus:
• Treating developer experience as a product
• Building paved roads, not one-off solutions
• Enabling AI-native software delivery
• Turning SDLC signals into actionable intelligence
 
Beyond the platform, I lead enterprise hackathons, mentor emerging leaders as a rotation manager in the Leadership Development Program, and serve on the CCSU Computer Science Industry Advisory Board.
 
Always up for talking platform strategy or AI-native delivery.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enterprise Platform Engineering leader responsible for the architecture, strategy, and operation of the enterprise developer platform ecosystem, spanning CI/CD, internal developer platforms, DevOps intelligence, AI/ML enablement, security, artifact management, and observability.

• On a CEO-sponsored initiative to make developer onboarding self-service - down from a 40+ day baseline
• Built a unified developer surface - custom CLI, desktop app, and IDE extensions - with 1,000+ engineers active in the first 90 days
• Built a single build command that works across any tech stack — locally, in CI, or fully remote — eliminating per-team build configuration entirely.
• Built a real-time DevOps intelligence: an event bus streaming pipeline and CLI/IDE telemetry into AWS, DynamoDB, and Snowflake for ML analysis of developer pain points; includes a live platform health status page with subscribable alerts
• Integrated native AI tooling and out-of-the-box MCP skills into the platform, enabling AI agents to interact with the DevOps intelligence layer
• Serve as solution architect for the Platform Engineering org, defining enterprise standards and long-term strategy across all CI/CD platforms
• Operate the enterprise CI/CD and DevSecOps toolchain end to end - Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness, AWS CodePipeline, Nexus, SonarQube, Checkmarx - keeping thousands of pipelines reliable
• Led the migration of 10,000+ repositories from GitHub Enterprise Server to GitHub Enterprise Cloud in under 12 months
• Recognized with the 2023 Enterprise Tech Data & Cyber Award for advancing platform adoption and developer productivity
positions.insights: Internal Developer Platforms (IDP), Developer Experience (DevEx) and +16 skills

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drove standardization of enterprise quality engineering platforms, spanning end-to-end automation, test data management, and validation.

• Led multiple teams delivering enterprise automated testing solutions across critical policy and downstream systems.
• Designed and implemented enterprise test data management and automated forms validation platforms
• Established and enforced SDLC and automation standards to ensure scalable, consistent test practices across the organization
• Optimized automation frameworks and test data strategies, reducing overall test execution time by 30%+
positions.insights: Quality Assurance, Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and +6 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned a batch processing platform modernization, transforming policy data from a new Policy Administration system into enterprise general ledger flat files used for premium reporting. Delivered within a SAFe model while consolidating 108 legacy applications into a single modern policy administration platform.

• Designed and delivered premium data integration pipelines supporting enterprise general ledger and external reporting requirements
• Established CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and uDeploy to enable reliable, automated batch delivery
• Implemented performance monitoring and alerting using Dynatrace and Sumo Logic to improve system visibility and stability
• Championed engineering best practices through code reviews, CI/CD optimization, and automation
• Mentored developers and enforced standards around code quality, versioning, and test coverage
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Development and +10 skills

honors.title: Tech Data & Cyber (TDAC) Developer Experience – Transformation Champion
honors.description: Awarded as a Transformation Champion on the Tech Data & Cyber (TDAC) Developer Experience – GitHub Actions team for driving enterprise-scale transformation and improving developer experience.

honors.title: Enterprise Hackathon Winner
honors.description: First place in the enterprise hackathon, created a reusable GitHub repository template that enabled teams to dynamically generate GitHub Pages dashboards for one to many repositories which enabled teams to track and manage GitHub issues at scale.
